sourceScopes.reviewNote: Conditional Probability & Bayes directly claims the definitions, multiplication/chain rule, law of total probability, Bayes formula, boys-and-girls, unfair-coin, Monty-Hall, candies-in-a-jar, and Russian-roulette-series material. All-girl world, fair extraction from an unfair coin, dart ranking, birthday line, dice order, amoeba population, recursive coin-toss game, aces allocation, gambler's ruin/random walk, basketball reinforcement, and cars-on-road are reviewed but remain outside this bounded workstream for later canonical topics.

Only Q3.10, Q3.11, Q3.14, Q3.15, and Q3.17 are claimed here. Q3.10 is the hidden double-headed-coin Bayes family; Q3.11 is a prior/model-ambiguity check; Q3.14-Q3.15 are two-child information variants; Q3.17 is Russian roulette after survival. The Q3.15 named-child wording is treated as observation-protocol dependent rather than copied mechanically. Adjacent General probability items remain for later canonical topics.

Brainteasers Question 2 is the only direct claimed item: observing a golden face reweights the latent object and is classified item-level as Conditional Probability & Bayes. The formal Probability/Stochastic Calculus boundary was also reviewed; its joint-normal conditional-probability Question 5 remains owned by Random Variables & Distributions, while distributions, LLN/CLT, martingales, and stochastic calculus remain outside this workstream.
